questions.prompt: Which of the following best reduces cardiac preload?

rationales.a: Venodilation reduces venous return, lowering preload.

questions.explanation: Nitrates primarily venodilate, dropping preload rather than afterload.

questions.prompt: Which of the following drugs reduce cardiac afterload? (select all that apply)

rationales.c: Furosemide is a diuretic, reduces preload not afterload.
rationales.e: Digoxin is inotropic, does not vasodilate.

questions.explanation: Arteriolar dilators and ARBs cut systemic vascular resistance, lowering afterload.

questions.prompt: A lesion in Broca's area most directly impairs which function?

rationales.b: Broca's area governs expressive/motor speech production.
